source_vintage_note: EECA Southland RETA Phase One Report dated 2022-10 (SRC-NZ-EECA-RETASOUTHLANDPHASE1-2022); EV-0052 delivered-cost tiers use PF Olsen analysis of AgriHQ Forestry Log Price Report (Southern South Island 3-year average prices to September 2021).
price_basis_note: Methodology/source confirmed directly from EECA RETA Section 7.7: pulp logs/export logs/pruned sawlogs costed via PF Olsen analysis of AgriHQ Forestry Log Price Report (Southern South Island 3-year average prices to September 2021); processor residues via Ahika cost analysis; in-forest residues via Scion/University of Canterbury/PF Olsen consultation. Real-vs-nominal basis and GST treatment are NOT stated in the held source and remain UNRESOLVED -- per docs/66/docs/67 task instruction, this does not block the diagnostic screen, only future production adoption.
accessibility_radius_note: 100 km is an Edendale accessibility/eligibility radius (SM-5.3-A; docs/01a_boundary_register.csv row 5). It is a scoping statement, not a cost-calculation input, and is not used computationally by this screen (docs/84 Section 3; docs/85 Section 4).
illustrative_transport_distance_note: 60 km is the illustrative transport-distance assumption embedded in EV-0052 published delivered-cost tiers (within EV-0052 stated 30-120 km transport-component range). Phase 3B does not rewrite or replace those published tier costs with a transport model (docs/85 Section 4).
delivered_cost_distance_qualification: The delivered-cost figures the screen produces are only demonstrated to be internally consistent for biomass sourced within an illustrative ~60 km radius; the wider ~100 km accessibility framing used elsewhere in the project is not shown to carry the same cost basis, and any future extension that treats the full 100 km radius as cost-equivalent to the 60 km-based tiers would need this reconciled first, not assumed. The full relationship between the 100 km eligible pool and the 60 km cost basis has not been independently reconciled because the underlying PF Olsen/Ahika primary reports are not held (docs/84 Section 3; docs/85 Section 4).
